summary: Claude Code took the one-line request and made the constant edit directly: find → read → Edit changing `const PAGE_SIZE = 10;` to `25`, then reported "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25." No brainstorming skill, no clarifying question, no permission-seeking.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria verified against the on-disk file and the authoritative session log: the edit was made directly and immediately, with no brainstorming skill invocation, no clarifying question, and no request for a go-ahead.

observations.description: Launch required four separate interactive confirmations (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) before the prompt was usable; each defaulted to 'No, exit' for the two trust prompts.
Status line reads 'Churned for 14s · done 1:13 AM' — 'Churned' is an odd word choice for elapsed work time.
The agent ran a Bash `find` to locate list.js before reading it; slightly more work than needed for a single-file repo, but harmless.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ⎿ Added 1 line, removed 1 line  1 - const PAGE_SIZE = 10;  1 + const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". On disk: `grep -n PAGE_SIZE coding-agent-workdir/list.js` → `1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;`. Session log tool_use sequence was only Bash(find list.js), Read, Edit(old_string "const PAGE_SIZE = 10;" → "const PAGE_SIZE = 25;").

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over the session log's assistant tool_use entries listed exactly three calls (Bash, Read, Edit) — no Skill call. `grep -o '"name":"Skill"'` returned 2 hits, both inside the injected system-prompt text (grep context shows them in the ladder instructions, line 5/6 system records), not in assistant tool_use. Only assistant text output was "`list.js:1` — `PAGE_SIZE` is now 25." — no question, no consequence, no permission request.
